# AmazingPlugins

> Free WooCommerce plugins for storefront accessibility fixes, shipping checks, and stale order cleanup.

Each plugin has a separate scope. Product pages describe its features and requirements.

## Plugins

- [Plugin catalog](https://amazingplugins.com/plugins/): Compare the available tools and their current installation options.
- [WooCommerce Accessibility Fixer](https://amazingplugins.com/plugins/woocommerce-accessibility-fixer/): Features and scope for common storefront markup fixes.
- [Accessibility Fixer on WordPress.org](https://wordpress.org/plugins/amazingplugins-accessibility-fixer-for-woocommerce/): Install the published plugin.
- [Shipping Rules Tester](https://amazingplugins.com/plugins/shipping-rules-tester-for-woocommerce/): Read-only checks for shipping zones and local rates. Submitted for WordPress.org review.
- [Shipping Rules Tester source](https://github.com/AmazingPlugins/shipping-rules-tester-for-woocommerce): Source code and manual installation instructions.
- [Stale Order Cleaner](https://amazingplugins.com/plugins/#stale-order-cleaner): Review old orders before permanent deletion. Source available on GitHub.

## Guides and support

- [Blog](https://amazingplugins.com/blog/): The current list of WooCommerce guides.
- [How to test WooCommerce shipping zones and rates](https://amazingplugins.com/blog/how-to-test-woocommerce-shipping-zones-and-rates/): Zone matching, free-shipping thresholds, sample packages, and final checkout checks.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://amazingplugins.com/faq/): Plugin requirements, supported features, and support details.
- [AmazingPlugins homepage](https://amazingplugins.com/): Project overview and contact information.
